name: CapCut Opacity Flicker Text With Tick SFX
use_when: A short text layer needs a quick electric, digital, or attention-grabbing flicker.
A hook word, title accent, or transition word should feel rhythmic with a tick/click sound.
The project tone supports a flashy social text accent.
avoid_when: The text is story-critical and must remain stable for accessibility.
The background already flickers or changes contrast heavily.
The subject is serious, emotional, or documentary-sensitive and the flicker would cheapen it.

timeline_pattern.pattern: text_layer -> six_blend_keyframes_one_frame_apart -> opacity_variation -> optional_keyframe_spacing_slowdown -> tick_sfx_cut_retime -> full_mix_qc
timeline_pattern.speed_rule: Keyframes one frame apart create a fast flicker; spacing them farther apart creates a slower flicker.
timeline_pattern.sfx_rule: Cut and retime tick/click SFX so it ends when the flicker ends.
timeline_pattern.readability_rule: The first and last frames should be readable so the viewer is not left with a half-visible word.

motion.rule: Animate opacity only unless the text also has a separate named motion job.

keyframe_values.keyframes: Six opacity keyframes can create the effect.
keyframe_values.spacing: Start with each keyframe 1 frame apart for a fast flicker; widen spacing for slower readability.
keyframe_values.opacity_sequence: Start 100, then 25, 50, 25, 67, end 100 as a tested CapCut pattern.

sound.rule: Use tiny ticks/clicks only under speech-safe levels, and clear the SFX tail when the flicker ends.

keyframe_values.sync: Ticks should land on or within 1-2 frames of the flicker pulses.
keyframe_values.tail: Trim, speed up, or fade the cue so it does not continue into the next word.

captions.rule: Do not flicker continuous subtitles; use it for designed emphasis text only.

color.rule: Avoid high-contrast color changes during the flicker unless the text remains readable in every opacity state.

implementation.ffmpeg: Animate text alpha with enable/opacity expressions or overlay a pre-rendered text layer with alpha values; align tick SFX with atrim/asetpts and afade.
implementation.remotion: Drive opacity from frame-indexed values like [100, 25, 50, 25, 67, 100] and trigger tick audio from the same frame list.
implementation.blender: Keyframe material alpha on text and align a short audio strip to the keyframes.
implementation.capcut_equivalent: On the text layer, add six Blend opacity keyframes, one frame apart for the fast version. Set opacity to 100, 25, 50, 25, 67, 100. Add a ticking SFX, cut it, and use speed controls so it ends with the flicker.
implementation.premiere_equivalent: Use Opacity keyframes on an Essential Graphics layer, duplicate or place tick SFX on each flicker pulse, and add short fades.

common_mistakes: Flickering text that needs to be read as accessibility captions.
Leaving the last frame semi-transparent instead of returning to readable opacity.
Letting ticking SFX continue after the visual flicker has ended.
Stacking flicker with shake, zoom, glow, and busy captions at the same moment.
Using the effect so often that it becomes visual noise.
qc: Does the final flicker frame return to full readable opacity?
Can the word be read at phone size through the flicker?
Does the tick/click end with the visual change and stay below dialogue?
Are captions, faces, proof, UI, products, and action safe?
Is the flicker reserved for a word that deserves extra attention?
